content_gaps: Top results define the measure but rarely compare nominal, real, and PPP side by side with current data.
Few explain what GDP per capita leaves out, such as distribution, unpaid work, and wealth.
None connects the measure to how investors should and should not use it.

verification_log.summary: Ubersuggest (United States) data retrieved 2026-10-12. BEA and the U.S. and India IMF figures confirmed. Fixes: malformed IMF U.S. link corrected; one internal link and the World Bank body link removed to meet link rules; chart built from the IMF table. Network opened 2026-10-12: five competitor pages read for each post (pages that blocked access were replaced by the next ranking page). Vendor pricing pages read directly and match. IMF WEO values for all six economies confirmed through the IMF data API (dataset WEO 9.0.0). CFA Institute wording on duties, coverage depth, and the Series 86 exemption confirmed. World Bank data confirmed to run through 2025. All cited links resolve; SEC and OECD block automated requests but the pages are valid. H3 expansion of 2026-10-12: every added sentence reviewed. No new figures. Product statements checked against vendor pages (Finviz Elite features, Koyfin Plus 10-year data); general statements on organic growth reporting, satellite accounts, and composite development indices worded so they hold without a specific figure.
